summary: Iteration 2 retest of ZOZOCIRCLE. All 5 reported fixes verified working. Backend regression suite re-run and extended (added tests/test_iter2_fixes.py): 78 passed, 1 xfail (brute-force lockout, deliberately out of V1 scope). Playwright verified: location bottom-sheet via portal on Home + Explore (mobile 390x844) and desktop 1440, real image upload end-to-end (seller onboard logo + product with 2 photos + service with 1 photo), upload-error surfacing, no navigate-during-render warnings on any /seller* route, brand-new seller redirect to /seller/start with zero console errors, admin verify seller + approve both listings, customer discovery of the new listings with correct distances, WhatsApp CTA wording for product vs service, favourites save/Saved page, PWA manifest+sw. Demo seed state restored afterwards (22 sellers, 24 listings, 3 pending sellers, 3 pending listings, 10 active categories); all TEST_* users/sellers/listings/categories from iterations 1 and 2 purged.

minor.issue: App-level CORS is now correct (OPTIONS on localhost:8001 returns the explicit origin + allow-credentials: true), but the preview k8s ingress rewrites the public response to 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' with no allow-credentials header. Cookie-based auth therefore cannot work cross-origin on the public URL; the app uses Bearer tokens so functionality is unaffected. Infra behaviour, not an app defect - no action needed for preview.
Still no brute-force lockout after 6 failed attempts (all 401). Deliberately deferred by main agent - test is now marked xfail, not a failure.
Still no DELETE endpoint (deferred by main agent).

A seller who picks a locality from the dropdown is stored at the exact locality centroid, so a customer whose location is that same locality sees '0 m away'. Seed sellers are jittered (fix 5) but self-registered sellers are not - consider applying the same jitter (or a 'Nearby' label below ~100 m).

issues: Rating renders a filled gold star followed by an em dash ('⭐ —'); for listings with no reviews the star should be muted/hidden or show 'New'
Last chip ('Repair') is clipped at the container edge with no scroll affordance/fade; horizontal scroll is not discoverable on desktop
Top-center sonner toast overlaps the 'Admin Dashboard' heading; consider top-right or an offset
Fixed bottom nav spans the full 1440px width while content is centered at max-w; acceptable for a mobile-first PWA but looks unfinished on desktop

action_items: Optional (low): jitter lat/lng for self-registered sellers who pick a locality from the dropdown, or render 'Nearby' instead of '0 m away' under ~100 m.

Optional (design): don't show a filled star with an em dash for 0-review listings; add a scroll fade to the Home category chip row on desktop; move the admin toast so it doesn't cover the page heading.
No blocking defects found - the 5 fixes are confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 614 lines and growing (auth + discovery + seller + admin + upload/storage in one module); split into routers before it crosses the 700-line threshold.

ListingDetail.jsx uses window.open(whatsappLink(...)) instead of an <a href> - popup blockers can silently swallow the CTA and the URL is not testable/inspectable. Rendering an anchor with target=_blank rel=noopener (and firing the counter on click) would be more robust.
Seed jitter is applied in seed() only; the same helper should be reused in POST /api/seller/profile for locality-picked coordinates so distance semantics are consistent.
ESLint: react/no-unescaped-entities in Home.jsx (2) and ListingDetail.jsx (1), plus pre-existing shadcn boilerplate warnings in ui/calendar.jsx and ui/command.jsx - cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows (all 5 fixes + full seller->admin->customer loop + PWA + mobile/desktop render)

Final DB state: 22 sellers (3 pending: seller20-22), 24 listings (3 pending), 10 active categories.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml (78 pass / 1 xfail baseline). test_seller_flow.py is order-dependent (module-scoped ctx) - keep loadscope. test_iter2_fixes.py covers favourites-404, seed jitter/radius monotonicity, distance_m vs Haversine (cross-checked against the 'sellers' mongo collection - note distances are exposed as distance_m in meters, and seller lat/lng are NOT in the public payload), and upload round-trip. The location bottom-sheet now works everywhere (portal), so no localStorage workaround is needed, but zz_loc / zz_radius presets still work. WhatsApp CTA is a button using window.open (no wa.me anchor) - hook window.open in Playwright to capture the URL. Run python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py after any UI/API test run to restore the demo seed state.
rca_of_the_issue: Two pre-existing pytest failures were resolved without touching product code: (1) the CORS test asserted on the public URL, but the preview ingress overwrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin with '*'; the test now asserts the app-level header on the internal port and only checks presence publicly. (2) test_detail_and_view_increment was flaky under xdist because parallel workers increment views on the same listing; the assertion is now '>= +1'. The lockout test is xfail (feature deliberately out of V1 scope).
